seoTitle: Nakshi Kantha Art: Samaha Subah and Bangladeshi Heritage
metaDescription: Nakshi kantha art meets new design: why B-POP Tags thanked Samaha Subah for helping Bangladeshi heritage set international trends. See the post here.
titleBn: সামাহা সুবাহ: নকশিকাঁথার ঐতিহ্যে আন্তর্জাতিক ট্রেন্ড
summaryBn: শিল্পী সামাহা সুবাহকে ধন্যবাদ জানিয়েছে বি-পপ ট্যাগস, কারণ তাঁর মতো উদ্ভাবকদের হাত ধরেই বাংলাদেশের ঐতিহ্য আন্তর্জাতিক ট্রেন্ড তৈরি করছে। পোস্টের #nakshikantha ট্যাগ আর কাঁথার সেলাইয়ের মতো নকশা তাঁর কাজের শেকড়ের দিকে ইঙ্গিত দেয়।
lede: A short thank-you with a big idea behind it: Samaha Subah's art is one reason Bangladeshi heritage is turning up in international trends.
body:
Some of our posts are simple thank-you notes, and this is one of them. B-POP Tags shared a tribute to **Samaha Subah** ([@samaha1507](https://www.instagram.com/samaha1507/)), crediting her work via [@siz.by.ss](https://www.instagram.com/siz.by.ss/) and [@rejectproject.shop](https://www.instagram.com/rejectproject.shop/) and tagging it #nakshikantha, a nod to nakshi kantha art and the Bangladeshi heritage it carries.

## Nakshi kantha art through a new lens

The caption makes one clear point: because of innovators like her, "Bangladeshi heritage is setting international trends". The cover graphic backs that up. Under a bold "WE FOUND ART" headline, a black-and-white portrait of the artist sits beside a dark panel of dashed, stitch-like lines arranged in diamonds and circles, a pattern that recalls the running stitch of a kantha. The other hashtags, #bangladeshrural and #arka, point the same way: back to rural craft, forward to contemporary design.

## Why we're paying attention

Heritage carried into new contexts is a recurring thread in our [Art & Fashion coverage](topic:art). It links this post to our tribute to [Bibi Russell](post:bibi-russell-queen-of-bangladeshi-fashion), to the sharper, futuristic edge of [cybersigilism in Bangladeshi fashion](post:cybersigilism-bangladeshi-fashion), and to artists like [Hridita Anisha](post:hridita-anisha-artist-profile), who build culture rather than decorate it.

Want to see more of Samaha Subah's work? Start with the accounts above, then find more artist spotlights on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcyhbIZGsjr/)
